notes:
Overview:
- Mid-market SaaS analytics product (customer-facing insights/search across product help & docs).
- Started with Hosted API for prototype embeddings + semantic search; moving to evaluation for Dedicated after cost/throughput analysis.
POC summary (hosted):
- Ingested ~120k docs via batch job (Airflow -> S3 -> hosted embeddings) over 48 hrs.
- Observed embedding throughput ~250 reqs/s with parallel workers; average embed cost higher than target.
- Retrieval latencies (Pinecone test index) ~20-40ms p50/p95 for 50 qps; aiming for <30ms p99 at 300 qps.
Requirements & targets:
- Workloads: embeddings-heavy plus semantic search retrieval. Bulk batch ingestion: target 500k documents/day. Real-time lookup throughput target: 500-1,000 qps for RPUs (many small queries).
- Latency SLO: retrieval <30ms p99 for 95% of traffic; cold-cache generation allowed to be slower.
- Cost sensitivity: tight margins — preference for predictable unit economics and autoscaling to optimize spend.
- Model prefs: evaluate smaller/optimized embedding models for cost, keep option to route to higher-quality model for low-volume/high-value queries.
- Vector DB integration: running PoC with Pinecone and pgvector; want native connector to their hosted vector DB and ability to run Dedicated with local vector store behind VPC.
Security / compliance notes:
- Must support SSO (SAML), SOC2-like audit logging, KMS integration. Data residency: US-only for production.
Stakeholders & quotes:
- Head of Product (Maya Lin): "We need predictable costs and <30ms retrieval at scale — not just average numbers."
- CTO (Ravi Sharma): cares about VPC-enabled Dedicated, network egress, and key management.
Sales/eng interactions:
- 2026-02-15: Intro demo — hosted API quickstart + embeddings flow (AE: Sam Patel).
- 2026-02-25: Hosted POC kickoff; Airflow batch tested, Fireflies ff_2026-02-25_2874 transcript.
- 2026-03-02: Pricing & Dedicated capabilities call; discussed GPU pool sizes, autoscaling, SLOs (Fireflies ff_2026-03-02_3912).
- 2026-03-11: Security questionnaire submitted; legal flagged data residency language.
Trials & results:
- Hosted API good for rapid prototyping; cost at scale materially higher than target.
- Need Dedicated POC to validate: 4x A100-equivalent pool, KV/prefix cache behavior for chat+retrieval, and throughput under steady-state batch + 1k qps read traffic.
Open questions:
- Can Redwood Dedicated provide predictable per-token + per-embedding pricing at committed capacity?
- How does autoscaling behave for bursty read patterns (short tail latency guarantees)?
- Can we route low-value queries to a cheaper model automatically?
Next steps (short):
- Confirm Dedicated POC dates (AE to propose week of 2026-03-22).
- Provide pricing worksheet for committed 3-6 month Dedicated contract.
- Legal to receive DPA + data residency addendum.

They validated concepts on Hosted API but need Dedicated POC to hit throughput and cost targets (bulk ingest and 500-1,000 qps reads). Main blockers: legal DPA/data residency and procurement pricing commitments. SE-led Dedicated POC is primary next step.
